column5: The bounded Rust leaf validates normalized signed-i64 handle intervals and converts them into ordered half-open TiDB record-key ranges with exact exclusive-low and inclusive-high PrefixNext behavior, points, disjoint ranges, contradictions, and MIN/MAX endpoints. Full RequestBuilder envelopes, partitions, common handles, indexes, paging, concurrency, row-count hints, FastBuffer allocation, replica policy, resource metadata, and every non-signed-handle range remain open.
